job.job_description:
KEY RESPONSABILITIES

Design and implement GenAI applications using LLMs, embeddings, and prompt orchestration patterns.
Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and supporting components.
Develop and maintain integrations with vector databases, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
Engineer prompts, evaluation strategies, and guardrails for quality, relevance, and safety.
Collaborate with product, architecture, and security teams to design scalable GenAI solutions.
Monitor GenAI application performance, cost, latency, and output quality.
Implement version control, testing, and deployment workflows for GenAI assets.
Support troubleshooting, iterative tuning, and operational improvement of GenAI applications.
Document solution design, limitations, risks, and technical decisions.

REQUIREMENTS

Strong Python skills and hands-on experience building AI applications.
Practical experience with LLM ecosystems and orchestration frameworks.
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search concepts.
Experience integrating AI services through APIs and enterprise systems.
Familiarity with cloud environments and containerization basics.
Hands-on with Git and basic CI/CD practices.
Awareness of AI risks such as hallucinations, privacy, prompt injection, and governance needs.
Strong communication, experimentation mindset, and pragmatic problem-solving.

NICE-TO-HAVE

Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search solutions.
Exposure to fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Knowledge of responsible AI, security controls, and enterprise AI governance.
Experience balancing model quality, latency, and cost in production use cases.
